_doc: Who-replaces-whom WR reallocation (statline_model.apply_wr_replacement). When a player with real usage (played the team's previous game; trailing carry share >= .20 or target share >= .12) is OUT/DOUBTFUL and the team's biggest target vacater is a WR, each remaining teammate gets frac[pos][rank] x vacated target share x team trailing targets x ppo_wr_tgt x points_scale added to final_projection (rank = depth by trailing target share among active same-position teammates, rank 4+ uses rank 3). Fit LOSO 2016-25 on analysis/who_replaces_whom/frame.parquet (nflverse only; 493 Friday-OUT WR events, split stable across all 10 folds). Only remaining-WR ranks 2/3 are applied: WR1-of-remaining (.08), TE (.04/.02/.03) and RB (.02-.05) cells were fit but did not improve held-out (see _fitted_not_applied). analysis/role_bump_chalk_gap, analysis/wr_out_redistribution. Off: DFS_WRW_WR=0.
